Package com.charitymap.model

Class Beneficiary

java.lang.Object
com.charitymap.model.Beneficiary
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Beneficiary extends Object implements Serializable
A beneficiary: a person or household in need of help.

A beneficiary is a mobile point on the map. It has a single aid need and is automatically linked to the closest distribution center that provides that exact kind of help. This link is the social heart of the project: the distance of this link measures how far someone in need must travel to be helped.

Author:
CharityMap team
